messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline.  Discuss how likely the predictions below are.  • Privacy will become a thing of the past. • By the early 2030s, we will be able to copy human consciousness to a computer. • Wireless Internet connection will be available anywhere on our planet. • All forms of transport will eventually become electric. • The effects of climate change will be irreversible. • Physical money (coins and notes) won't exist anymore. • Scientists will unlock the genetic secrets that could allow us to live for centuries, maybe forever.

message.content:
Likelihood that privacy will become a thing of the past is low because offline spaces, personal relationships, and laws can still protect private information, although digital privacy will be much harder to preserve Likelihood
Likelihood that we can copy human consciousness to a computer by the early 2030s is very low because we still lack a complete scientific model of consciousness and safe full-brain replication methods are far beyond current technology Likelihood
Likelihood that wireless Internet connection will be available anywhere on our planet is moderate to high because satellite and cellular networks are expanding, but deep oceans, dense interiors, and some remote regions may remain poorly covered for a long time Likelihood
Likelihood that all forms of transport will eventually become electric is high over centuries because batteries and charging infrastructure are improving and fuel cells may help heavy transport, though aviation and shipping will be difficult and slow Likelihood
Likelihood that the effects of climate change will be irreversible is high for some impacts because melting ice, ocean warming, and ecosystem shifts may persist even if emissions stop, although the total damage can still be reduced Likelihood
Likelihood that physical money will no longer exist is moderate because digital payments are becoming common and governments may reduce cash, but coins and notes are likely to persist as legal tender and emergency backup Likelihood
Likelihood that scientists will unlock genetic secrets allowing humans to live for centuries or forever is very low because aging is complex, and while lifespan may increase substantially, radical life extension or immortality is much less certain within this century Likelihood
